Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Singleton
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/08/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 241 could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of petitions consulted on and prepared for a petitioner by an attorney prior to official appointment and subject to approval by the probate judge.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
